description: This file defines the `RefreshTokenRepository` class which implements methods to manage OAuth refresh tokens, including persisting new tokens, revoking tokens, checking if tokens are revoked, and creating new token instances. It is part of the OAuth plugin for the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: RefreshTokenRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing OAuth refresh tokens, implementing persistence, revocation, and token creation methods, integrated with Doctrine ORM and the OAuth2 server library.

methods.name: persistNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Persists a new refresh token entity into the database, converting the domain entity to a database entity and handling unique constraint violations.

methods.name: revokeRefreshToken
methods.description: Marks a refresh token as revoked in the database based on its token ID.

methods.name: isRefreshTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks if a specific refresh token has been revoked; returns true if revoked or not found.

methods.name: getNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of a refresh token entity.
